## Inovia at a glance

Inovia Capital is the leading full-stack venture capital firm anchored in Canada, with an established presence in the EU. We partner with founders to build impactful and enduring global companies.

With investments spanning from pre-seed to pre-IPO, and a team of seasoned investors, operators, and advisors, we support founders with capital, insights, and mentorship at every stage. We’ve been at the forefront of technology shifts since the dawn of the internet and mobile era in the ’90s — and today, we continue that legacy by backing innovators in emerging technologies, including [Generative AI](https://www.inovia.vc/inovia-gen-ai-overview/).

[View our portfolio](https://www.inovia.vc/active-companies/) [About us](https://www.inovia.vc/about/)
